notes.title: Devlog #02: Forging the Hero’s Tools
notes.notes:
[h3][b]Welcome back adventurers![/b][/h3][p][/p][p]In our [url="https://steamcommunity.com/games/2893820/announcements/detail/532108091999651205?snr=2___"]first devlog[/url], we explored the [b]foundations of combat[/b] and how Tristan grows [b]from a humble cartographer into a capable fighter[/b]. But battles alone aren’t enough to survive the island. Every wound needs tending, every journey demands supplies, and every hero needs [b]tools [/b]worthy of the trials ahead.[/p][p][/p][p]That’s where [b]crafting[/b] comes in: a system that turns raw materials into the weapons, armor, food, and potions that allow your journey to continue.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/qimBKek.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]When Tristan first sets foot on the island, he can roast meat over a fire, throw together a simple meal, but not much else. To thrive here, he’ll need to learn how to [b]forge[/b], [b]brew[/b], and [b]cook [/b]to [b]prepare[/b] for what the island throws at him.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]From Campfire to Master Forge[/b][/h2][p]Crafting begins small. A campfire meal, a sharpened blade, a healing potion. But as you find teachers, unlock recipes, and train your skills, the possibilities expand. [b]Whatever you craft [/b]will find its use at the right moment, sometimes [b]saving your life[/b].[/p][p][/p][p][b]Food [/b]can go beyond restoring health and stamina: full meals provide [b]lasting bonuses[/b] to [b]strength[/b], [b]endurance[/b], or [b]resistance[/b], allowing you to be better prepared for dangerous adventures.[/p][p]
[b]Potions [/b]are not only [b]valuable out of combat, [/b]but also[b] in combat,[/b] since you can’t have a mid-battle snack. A quick draught of a [b]healing [/b]or [b]stamina [/b]potion can determine whether you live to strike back.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/Xcczrl0.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Moreover, not every brew is used for recovery and defensive purposes: [b]poisons [/b]can be [b]applied to weapons[/b], giving your blade a temporary edge, whether it’s causing enemies to bleed faster, or weakening them with venom.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Gathering Materials[/b][/h2][p]Every recipe requires ingredients: after all, you can’t make an omelet without eggs. Some resources are [b]common[/b];  [b]herbs [/b]can be gathered in the wild, animals hunted for [b]meat[/b], [b]fish [/b]caught in rivers, or [b]eggs [/b]collected from chickens on farms. You can [b]mine ores[/b] or even [b]smelt scrap[/b] at the furnace into [b]ingots[/b], forming the basis for weapons.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/CO6DtKt.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Other resources may require more effort. Certain [b]rare plants [/b]or [b]monster-related ingredients[/b] lie hidden in dangerous regions, guarded by creatures that won’t give them up easily. Merchants, quests, and factions can also provide access to special resources, but none of them dictate your path: you can [b]decide whether to rely on trade, quest rewards, or gathering everything yourself.[/b][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Weapons, Armor, and the “Legend”[/b][/h2][p]Weapons forged by your own hand often come with lower stat requirements than those scavenged from the world. This means you can equip and use them earlier in your journey, giving you reliable options before rarer loot becomes available. But the true art lies with the [b]Master Blacksmith[/b] skill. Reaching it allows you to design a unique blade: [b]the[/b] [b]Legend[/b].[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/jyGr2xD.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]This isn’t just another sword. It’s [b]customizable[/b], [b]upgradable[/b], and can absorb rare weapons found across the island. With enough dedication, it [b]may become one of the strongest weapons in the game[/b]… but never the only one. Many other rare arms rival it, each with unique properties, so [b]both crafters and adventurers have paths to power.[/b][/p][p]
[b]Armor[/b] follows a different path. Most sets can be discovered, but through [b]reinforcement[/b] you can fortify them beyond their base strength. At high levels, even ordinary armor can surpass expectations. Some pieces grant [b]specific bonuses[/b], while others focus on raw [b]defense.[/b][/p][p][/p][h2][b]The Choice is Yours[/b][/h2][p]Crafting in [b]Of Ash and Steel[/b] is [b]simple in structure but deep in possibilities[/b]. The more you craft, the more perks and bonuses you unlock, from weapon sharpening to armor strengthening.[/p][p][/p][p]While merchants, quests, and factions all shape what you can access, none of them dictate your path. You might forge every tool yourself, or rely on loot and trade. You might become a [b]blacksmith [/b]known for blades, or an [b]alchemist [/b]living off potions. [b]The island allows both and rewards those who experiment.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]From the first cut of roasted meat to a legendary sword of your own design, [b]crafting is yet another way to make your story truly yours[/b]. It's more than just a set of bonuses: it’s the feeling of holding a weapon you forged yourself and personalizing it to your liking, brewing your potions so you don’t have to buy them at the market, or making your armor both strong and epic to look at.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for joining us for this second devlog! We’ll meet again soon![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Add Of Ash and Steel to your Wishlist[/b][/h3][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2893820/Of_Ash_and_Steel/"][/dynamiclink][/p][list][*][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fx.com%2FOfAshandSteel"]Twitter[/url][/p][/*][*][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.reddit.com%2Fr%2FOfAshandSteel%2F"]Reddit[/url][/p][/*][*][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.gg%2F55putKmsDm"]Discord[/url][/p][/*][*][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fbsky.app%2Fprofile%2Fofashandsteel.bsky.social"]Bluesky[/url][/p][/*][*][p][url="https://www.tiktok.com/@ofashandsteel"]TikTok[/url][/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Devlog #01: Combat Styles & Weapon Mastery
notes.notes:
[p][b][i]Adventurers![/i][/b][/p][p][/p][p]Today, we want to lead you on an exploration of the [b]combat system: how stances work, how weapons feel in your hands, and how mastery makes you deadlier with each fight.[/b][/p][p]At the beginning of [b]Of Ash and Steel[/b], Tristan isn’t a seasoned warrior: [b]he’s just a cartographer.[/b] Surviving the dangers of the island means he must grow into a fighter, learning [b]new combat stances[/b], [b]mastering weapons[/b], and eventually [b]unlocking powers far beyond his humble beginnings[/b].[/p][p][/p][h3][b]The Language of Stances[/b][/h3][p]As Tristan begins his journey as an ordinary man, he doesn't immediately know how to fight. To unlock combat stances, you’ll need to seek out teachers who can pass down their martial knowledge.
[/p][p]There are [b]7 combat stances in total:[/b][/p][list][*][p]3 for [b]one-handed weapons[/b][/p][/*][*][p]3 for [b]two-handed weapons[/b][/p][/*][*][p]1 unique stance for the [b]rapier[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Each stance has its own tactical identity. Power stances deliver heavy blows and can stagger enemies, but they’re slow, leaving you open against quicker foes. Fast stances, on the other hand, sacrifice raw damage for speed, letting you unleash a flurry of attacks. Every hit in a combo strengthens the stance’s modifier: by the fifth strike in a heavy combo, your chance to stagger is already boosted by 25%.[/p][p][/p][p]And yes, you can [b]switch stances right in the middle of combat[/b]. At higher skill levels, you can even change stance mid-combo, keeping your chain of bonuses going.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/U7Fhb44.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Every Weapon has its Purpose[/b][/h3][p]Not every weapon can use every stance. Universal weapons like one-handed and two-handed swords allow full flexibility. But others are more specialized. For example, daggers are locked to fast stances, while two-handed axes stick to power and circular stances.[/p][p][/p][p]These limits are balanced by [b]weapon-specific bonuses[/b]: for example, an axe might not allow finesse stances, but its raw destructive potential more than makes up for it. Stances don’t just affect damage, they influence movement, defense, stamina use, and how your character feels in battle.[/p][p][/p][p]Weapons fall into three global categories: [b]one-handed, two-handed, [/b]and [b]agility weapons[/b], with sub-categories like swords, maces, axes, and more. Each has unique stats: speed, reach, type of damage, and special effects such as higher crit chance or stagger potential.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/AB4SzlL.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]To illustrate:[/p][list][*][p]A rapier deals piercing damage. It’s fast, precise, and pairs well with bleeding skills, letting you wear enemies down while staying mobile.[/p][/*][*][p]A two-handed axe delivers colossal slashing damage, devastating groups of enemies in wide sweeps.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Both are deadly, but in very different ways.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]The Path to Mastery[/b][/h3][p]Fighting isn’t just about the weapon in your hand: it’s about how well you’ve mastered it. One-handed and two-handed weapons each have their [b]own mastery trees[/b], filled with both passive and active abilities. Rapiers, meanwhile, tie into survival and thievery skills, adding another layer of progression.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/5QRxsVM.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]As your mastery improves, you’ll unlock:[/p][list][*][p][b]Increased damage[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Longer combos[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Unique finishing blows (at mastery level 3)[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Active combat skills like shoulder strikes or sweeping 180° attacks[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Each weapon stance also comes with its own set of combos and finishers. Our team recommends you try a heavy hammer finisher at least once: it’s as brutal as it sounds 😁[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/HG4sxZ3.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Strike Where It Hurts[/b][/h3][p]Combat isn’t just about what you bring into battle, it’s also about what your enemies throw at you. Different foes have strengths and weaknesses against specific stances or weapons.[/p][p][/p][p]Fast enemies are dangerous if you try to face them in a power stance. With them you’ll want a quicker approach. But some opponents are highly vulnerable to strong stagger attacks from heavy stances. Hobsters, for example, usually attack in groups, and the more AOE stance is perfect for cutting them down. Experimentation is key![/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/VID0yW2.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b](Ancient) Knowledge is Power[/b][/h3][p]Around the mid-game, combat evolves once more when Tristan taps into Ancient Knowledge. These long-lost powers don’t require any special resource to use but are limited by a cooldown, making them incredibly valuable in both duels and large battles.[/p][p][/p][p]What kind of devastating abilities can you unleash? That remains a secret… [b][i]for now.[/i][/b][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Forging a Warrior[/b][/h3][p]At the heart of combat lies a balance between player skill and character preparation. Precision, timing, and quick thinking are crucial, but so are your stance choices, weapons, and buffs. A talented player can win against the odds, but the smartest fighters will come armed with the right gear and abilities.[/p][p][/p][p]Of Ash and Steel builds an [b]invisible bond between you and Tristan[/b]. At the start, neither of you knows much: he has no experience in combat, and you’re just beginning to understand the system. As you learn how to manage stamina, master timings, and adapt your style, Tristan also grows stronger, unlocking new skills, stances, and ways to survive even those fights that seemed impossible a few hours ago.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/WEu474d.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]The more you play, the more you both improve, with you helping a cartographer who knew nothing of battle to become a warrior ready to change the island’s destiny.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your company during this devlog, we will be seeing you soon with a new one![/p][list][*][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2893820/Of_Ash_and_Steel/"]Wishlist now[/url][/p][/*][*][p][url="https://x.com/OfAshandSteel"]Twitter[/url][/p][/*][*][p][url="https://www.reddit.com/r/OfAshandSteel/"]Reddit[/url][/p][/*][*][p][url="https://discord.gg/55putKmsDm"]Discord[/url][/p][/*][*][p][url="https://bsky.app/profile/ofashandsteel.bsky.social"]Bluesky[/url][/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Of Ash and Steel: End of the Playtest + One Last Secret
notes.notes: [p][b][i]Adventurers![/i][/b][/p][p][/p][p]Your passion, dedication, and feedback have been nothing short of incredible. Thanks to you, the Of Ash and Steel Playtest has reached these milestones:[/p][list][*][p][b]120,000+ playtesters[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]300+ bugs fixed[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]50+ quality-of-life updates delivered[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Every step of this journey was possible because of your contributions, helping us shape the game on its path to release, and for this we are truly grateful![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45307617/e2e7576c5007ba6b8bfa81152dd2740fb06c6c01.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Of course, development doesn’t stop here. We’ll continue internal testing, with a focus on some of the most important points raised during the Playtest, such as [b]pathfinding for AI, memory management, and several other improvements[/b] from your [b]feedback[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]The Playtest will close on August 26th. But before the gates shut, we’ve added one last surprise in a small update:[/p][p][/p][p][i]"An unusual crystal has appeared within the Skeleton Fortress. Seek it out to unlock new skills, ancient knowledge, and powerful equipment.[/i][/p][p][i]But beware, for the crystal brings its own dangers..."[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45307617/cfbb34fcceb9ee81bcb76956c8802fee69f4ecd8.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Will you venture onto the Island one last time to unravel this final secret? Stay tuned for more news soon, and thanks again for the support![/p][p][/p][list][*][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2893820/Of_Ash_and_Steel/"]Wishlist now[/url][/p][/*][*][p][url="https://x.com/OfAshandSteel"]Twitter[/url][/p][/*][*][p][url="https://www.reddit.com/r/OfAshandSteel/"]Reddit[/url][/p][/*][*][p][url="https://discord.gg/55putKmsDm"]Discord[/url][/p][/*][*][p][url="https://bsky.app/profile/ofashandsteel.bsky.social"]Bluesky[/url][/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: New Gameplay Trailer from Gamescom
notes.notes:
[p][b][i]Hello adventurers![/i][/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]Of Ash and Steel[/b] is currently at [b]Gamescom[/b], where members of the press are having the chance to play [b]Of Ash and Steel[/b] for the very first time. For the occasion, we have prepared a new Gameplay trailer, so take a look![/p][p][/p][h2][b]Watch the new Gameplay Trailer[/b][/h2][previewyoutube="Z7zhbLofCdY;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]The new trailer offers a sweeping look at the choices, challenges, and adventures awaiting you in [b]Of Ash and Steel[/b].[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Combat & Mastery[/b][/h3][p]Unlock multiple combat stances, master different weapon types, from swift rapiers to heavy two-handed axes, and learn special abilities that make you deadlier with each encounter.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/uihsso0.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Factions & Choices[/b][/h3][p]Your allegiances shape your story. Follow the path of knighthood with the Order of the Seven, embrace the Freehunters’ greater good goal or work for one of the island’s rival guilds. Every choice affects the quests you face and the fate of those around you.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/Er4NLdp.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Survival & Home[/b][/h3][p]Choose how you rest between adventures: set up a camp in the wilderness, rent a modest room, or purchase and furnish a home to your taste. Functional upgrades and personal touches turn your base into more than just a place to sleep.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/eQXseYJ.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Side Activities[/b][/h3][p]Hunt, fish, follow clues to hidden treasure, craft and upgrade your gear, or even resort to stealing if that’s your path.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/NVljhiB.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]What’s Next[/b][/h2][p]In the coming months, we’ll be sharing a series of devlogs that explore the game’s core features in greater detail, from combat and factions to crafting and progression.[/p][p][/p][p]Until then, don’t forget to [b]wishlist the game on Steam, join our Discord [/b]and [b]follow us on Social[/b] to stay up to date and be ready for launch!

notes.title: An ambitious upcoming Eurojank RPG is holding a closed playtest on Steam and it's probably worth your time if you're into that sort of thing
notes.notes: Of Ash and Steel is a third-person open world RPG that sets players off on a once-prosperous island to explore, fight, and "shape the fate of the world," or at least the fate of the island. It's still early in development (which presumably explains the lack of detail on what the game is actually about) but developer Fire and Frost has kicked off a playtest on Steam, so you can get an early look at what it's all about... Read more.

notes.title: Of Ash and Steel Closed Playtest Has Begun
notes.notes:
[p][b][i]Greetings, adventurers![/i][/b][/p][p][/p][p]We are excited to share that the [b]closed[/b] [b]playtest for Of Ash and Steel has just begun![/b][/p][p]Please check your emails if you’ve signed up for the playtest previously. We will let the players in waves.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45307617/0bb45075cb18fc996e37c9ac3ec447a630432ee5.png"][/img]
[/p][h2]What’s in the Playtest?[/h2][p]This early version of the game includes the [b]Prologue[/b] and the first steps into [b]Chapter 1[/b]. You’ll begin in the grotto, where your journey kicks off with a few unexpected tasks and characters. From there, you’ll enter the Forgotten Reach, a quiet but unforgiving corner of the island. Here you’ll get a glimpse of the main quest, face your first fights, craft a few essential items, try some side activities like fishing and uncovering hidden treasures, and discover the island at your own pace.
[/p][p]Enemies won’t go easy on you, especially early on: you’ll need to learn how to fight, gear up, and choose your battles wisely![/p][p][/p][h2]A packed first visit to the Island[/h2][p]Even in this short playtest, the island of Grayshaft rewards the curious, adventurous and those who seek a challenging fight![/p][p]If you look closely, you may stumble across buried treasure, a locked cave behind a riddle, or eerie encounters in the night, so keep your eyes open![/p][p][/p][h2]Join our official Discord[/h2][p]Join our community [u][url="https://discord.gg/QDZNNxZmE4"]Discord server[/url][/u] and share your feedback with us directly, and chat with other adventurers! [/p][p][/p][p]See you on the island![/p]

notes.title: Going Hands-On With Of Ash And Steel—Twisted Metal
notes.notes:
I was immediately intrigued by Of Ash and Steel when I saw it, specifically because of how ambitious it looked for an indie project. For what appears to be the first game by developer Fire & Frost, its size and scope as an action RPG seemed pretty impressive, and I’m always on board with indie studios punching above their weight if they can manage it.

Getting to go hands-on with Of Ash and Steel was a bit of a conflicting experience. There’s a lot I want to like about it—heck, there’s a lot TO like about it. But it’s also pretty clear it may need a few more months in the oven to fully cook. Fire & Frost supposedly were inspired to make RPGs that captured the style and feel of 2000s-era RPGs, and I would definitely say Of Ash and Steel is giving me those vibes—for better and worse.

Of Ash and Steel puts players in the medieval boots of a humble cartographer named Tristan. “In the wake of certain events in the capital of Asteria,” he journeys with a small... Read more

notes.title: New World Overview Trailer & Playtest Sign-Up
notes.notes:
[i][b]Greetings, adventurers![/b][/i]

Our game was just featured at [b]tinyBuild Connect 2025[/b] with a [b]brand-new trailer[/b] showcasing the beautiful and dangerous world of Of Ash and Steel.

We invite you to hear from Tristan, a cartographer by trade and our hero by chance, as he guides you through the island of Grayshaft, its ecosystem, climate, and inhabitants (some more welcoming than others).

Starting today, you can also sign up for the upcoming closed playtest to experience the first few quests and the beginning of Tristan's journey. This is the first time we have let someone outside of the development team, our friends and family, and the publisher step foot onto Grayshaft! We will share more details on what to expect from this playtest in the coming days.

[h2][b]Head over to the Of Ash and Steel Steam page and click on the 'Request Access' button![/b][/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2893820/Of_Ash_and_Steel/

We will let the players into the playtest in waves, so please keep an eye out for your email notifications.

[h2][b]Check out the World Overview Trailer[/b][/h2]
[previewyoutube=MWe9CU1JFAc;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3][b]Welcome to Grayshaft[/b][/h3]
Grayshaft is one of the islands of the Kingdom of the Seven. This island is beautiful, that much is certain: peaceful meadows stretch alongside endless crop fields, while small creeks wind their way through quiet hills and past sleepy villages. But thick, ancient forests soon take over the horizon, shrouding crumbling ruins and long-forgotten relics.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45307617/ca7678caf584a37f8fcffcbd83ca955bec525965.gif[/img]

Some folks describe the island as an entity, temperamental and unstable whenever it decides so. The weather turns on a whim, with a gentle breeze becoming a violent storm in moments. While some parts of the island bloom with color and life, others are locked in a frozen grip all year round. Even the ancient volcano at the heart of this area can’t warm up the lands it overlooks.

[img]https://media4.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExdmI3bWVheW5semp3dmxobmZ5amZyYzF3eHdyb3Q5cm5rMjlxcWQxMCZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/YebDqXI7ESw1GncES9/giphy.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Dangers in Every Step[/b][/h3]
Danger is never far behind. Whether wandering well-worn roads or exploring hidden paths, you’ll face bloodthirsty beasts, ruthless scavengers, and monstrous creatures. Heck, the bugs alone are the stuff of nightmares! Make one wrong move, and it could be your last.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45307617/f6996dc52dffdbbff4c156ee9da96d7eb13bccd4.gif[/img]

But for those who press on, curiosity and courage are rewarded: hidden caves, buried treasures, and long-lost secrets await those brave enough to look where others didn’t dare to. Just look over your shoulder while exploring, or you might become another lost soul of the island.

[h3][b]Factions and Power Struggles[/b][/h3]
Wildlife, bandits and monsters are not the only dangerous entities on the island: Grayshaft is also home to factions, some of which are vying for control and power. The Order of the Seven stands tall with their code and discipline, while the Free Hunters answer to no one but their own sense of justice. Many more groups operate in the shadows or on the fringes of society, and you’ll never know who to trust at first glance. Rule of thumb: assume everything’s out to get you, and you’ll only be surprised when it’s not.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45307617/38035accfc02142a1b9296774f8055421bc8f3c7.gif[/img]

That’s all for today! 
We’re thrilled to begin unveiling the world of Of Ash and Steel to everyone, and this is just the beginning. Wishlist the game and stay tuned: more reveals and devlogs are coming soon.

[b]See you on the island![/b]

notes.title: Of Ash and Steel: The Development in Numbers
notes.notes:
[b]Greetings, adventurers! We bring you news from the Island![/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/IFP399W.gif[/img]

We’re incredibly grateful for all the support you've shown over the past few months for us and [b]Of Ash and Steel[/b]. Since our last devlog, we've been working tirelessly behind the scenes, and that effort is finally bearing fruit. For a young studio like ours, this journey has been nothing short of thrilling and truly epic.
Today, we're excited to share what we’ve accomplished and brought to life:

[list]
[*] 300+ quests
[*] 30,000+ lines of dialogue
[*] 270+ pieces of armor, clothing, rings, and amulets
[*] 180+ weapons
[*] 30+ monsters
[*] 200+ crafting recipes
[*] 3 unique pets
[*] 5+ hours of original in-game music
[*] 50+ buried treasures
[*] 80+ random world events
[*] And much more!
[/list]
We are still testing, optimizing, and polishing so that, at launch, we can offer you the best experience. This phase is every bit as important as core development, but now that we can see the end of the road, every breath feels a little lighter!

And there’s even more ahead! We’ll be ramping up promotional activities in the coming weeks to spread the word about [b]Of Ash and Steel[/b] to as many adventurers as possible. At the same time, we’ll start sharing more cool things that we have under wraps, including story details and new game mechanics.

notes.title: Q&A with the Devs №4
notes.notes:
[b]Greetings, adventurers![/b]

Thank you for all the questions you left for us on Steam and Discord for Of Ash and Steel. With today we conclude our Q&A Session with the Devs with Part 4, but we will repeat this for sure in the future!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45307617/cd5276776c70597ee6982cdd55f4c6ad1eed5ec4.png[/img]

[b] Q: Is Of Ash and Steel a linear game, or can players deviate from the main objective and alter the outcomes? [/b]
A: Of course, it’s an RPG. Everything is in your hands, and your decisions will affect many things.

[b] Q: How deeply are interactivity and immersion developed in Of Ash and Steel? [/b]
A: As much as possible. From small activities like fishing to simply sitting down and playing the guitar.

[b] Q: Will NPCs sleep at night so the player can rob their houses and chests? [/b]
A: Yes. But it’s better to come during the day when everyone is at work...

[b] Q: Will there be many quests with branching paths? How many of these will be part of the main storyline? Are there any unique or even secret solutions in quests? [/b]
A: Quite a lot. We’ve paid great attention to this. You can expect many tasks that require careful exploration.

[b] Q: Will there be enemies (among humans) larger than the main character, like "big guys"? [/b]
A: Yes, the big guys are here.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45307617/d6f548b9aea3badd7636b02e3b7754dc3d4088a1.png[/img]

[b] Q: How big is the game world? [/b]
A: It’s big enough to keep exploring interesting even after 100 hours, but not so bloated that exploration feels like a chore.

[b] Q: Are the seven islands and seven gods somehow connected? [/b]
A: Everything is connected. And there are seven days in a week too...

[b] Q: Will the game feature real estate and the ability to customize it? [/b]
A: Yes! At some point, you’ll be able to purchase your own estate in a dilapidated state and gradually improve it, gaining great bonuses and even rare herbs from your garden. And where there’s a flourishing estate, there are people who want to take it from you...

[b] Q: Will the game have survival elements, like the need to sleep or eat? [/b]
A: Yes, but within reason. At the start, you’ll need to monitor hunger, thirst, and fatigue, but over time, these stats will grow. At that point, survival mechanics will feel more like an opportunity to buff your character before a tough fight.

[b] Q: Will there be a library in the city? What about arenas or brothels? [/b]
A: Yes, you can find all of these along the way, including a library and a bookstore in the city.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45307617/be4dd30b92066a84c861d5f3a7ce2281fd94ea75.jpg[/img]

[b] Q: Will there be crafting for jewelry (rings, amulets)? [/b]
A: Of course.

[b] Q: Will we encounter underground monster bosses in the game, like the Minecrawler Queen from Gothic? [/b]
A: Yes. Beware of crypts, and don’t go in without a torch.

[b] Q: Will the game feature crossbows, or only bows? [/b]
A: You’ll find both crossbows and bows in the game.

[b] Q: How are crossbows different from bows in the game? [/b]
A: Crossbows take longer to reload but offer a wider variety of ammunition and greater stopping power.

[b] Q: Will weapons bounce off heavy armor when struck and produce different sounds depending on the armor type? [/b]
A: Generally, the sturdier the armor looks, the more damage it absorbs. Sounds depend not only on the armor type but also on the weapon type you use to attack — we’ve put a lot of effort into this.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45307617/435248ea468878f447582889e528af1c81f77e90.png[/img]

[b] Q: Will weapons wear out and break? If so, will broken weapons be irreparable if left unfixed? [/b]
A: No, weapons don’t wear out. However, you can reinforce weapons and armor, making them permanently better.

[b] Q: How is lockpicking implemented? [/b]
A: We have two types of locks: standard and complex. For standard locks, you need to turn the lockpick to the end while carefully adjusting its angle as you feel resistance. For complex locks, you’ll need to find a special key and turn it in the correct directions the proper number of times.

[b] Q: What about stealing and stealth mechanics? [/b]
A: We have a mini-game for this. Approach a character and start rummaging through their pockets. You’ll see a pouch with 9 slots. Carefully feel around to find the items you need while avoiding danger zones. The higher your agility, the lower your chances of being caught.

[b] Q: Can players roleplay as villains and scoundrels? [/b]
A: You can’t play as an outright sadist or villain, but you can roleplay as a cunning and money-hungry character. Plus, some of your decisions will determine the fate of entire communities.

[b] Q: Will there be an option to perform stealth kills and hide bodies? [/b]
A: The game offers plenty of ways to reduce enemy numbers through dirty tricks, such as dropping barrels on their heads or collapsing unstable structures. However, hiding bodies is not possible.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45307617/0f900178263fce53950f2dbb7467f0918d5a540d.png[/img]

[b] Q: In one of the trailers, the hero used acceleration to deliver a surprise attack behind an enemy. The movement was highlighted with a magical silhouette. Is this Ancient Knowledge? If I play as a warrior, can I complete the game without using such magical abilities? [/b]
A: That’s one of the skills, yes. You can avoid using it in combat, but for warriors, it costs nothing to use, although it does have a long cooldown.

[b] Q: Will there be dirty fighting skills, like throwing sand in an enemy's eyes or kicking them? [/b]
A: Yes! The survival skill tree covers this. You’ll be able to throw sand, make quick dagger throws, coat weapons with poison, use the environment to your advantage, and more.

[b] Q: Is there a punishment system for crimes? [/b]
A: Yes, and each region has its own system of law and order.

[b] Q: Can players commit crimes and go unpunished if done discreetly? [/b]
A: A good thief is one who doesn’t get caught.

[b] Q: Will the game be optimized for weaker PCs? [/b]
A: We’re doing our best to optimize everything possible. This is an important point for us.

[img]https://i.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExNWZ0bWQybmIyaXJlOXFsZXNob2s4YzQ1OWE0eWNhb2Voajg4cDY2ayZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/U2Q6BrVkF056aRyaBT/giphy-downsized-large.gif[/img]

Once again, thank you for your questions and interest in the project, we can't wait to reveal you more about Of Ash and Steel!

notes.title: Q&A with the Devs №3
notes.notes:
[b]Greetings, adventurers![/b]

Thank you for all the questions you left for us on Steam and Discord for Of Ash and Steel. Welcome to Part 3 of the Q&A Session!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45307617/28cc688e97ac8d8ce98ec28727791efde63ef014.jpg[/img]

[b]Q: How is Ancient Knowledge in your game different from the magic we're all used to seeing?[/b]
A: Traditionally, magic is about casting fireballs left and right. In the Of Ash and Steel universe, magic is a very delicate matter that isn't used casually for combat. Every use of magical arts is a significant event. Ancient Knowledge allows the wielder to draw just a fraction of the power of the Seven.

[b]Q: Approximately how long will it take to complete the game?[/b]
A: We estimate about 30 hours for a quick playthrough, and twice as much for a more detailed one.

[b]Q: Will there be Xbox controller support?[/b]
A: Most likely, yes.

[b]Q: Will there be visible damage from hits and/or blood on melee weapons?[/b]
A: Blood remains on both the enemy and the player.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45307617/3b18be605234ec1b95750b186119828427152df7.jpg[/img]

[b]Q: Will all equipment (clothing, rings, etc.) be visible on the character model?[/b]
A: Everything except necklaces (though we might add those as well).

[b]Q: Have you considered the option to fully or partially disable the HUD?[/b]
A: For screenshots, we have a photo mode that disables the HUD, but we may add this as a general option in the future.

[b]Q: Will there be helmets, shields, bracers, boots, etc., or is the armor unified?[/b]
A: There will be helmets, upper body armor, lower body armor, slots for two rings, and a necklace.

[b]Q: Will there be adventure stats displayed numerically?[/b]
A: Yes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45307617/f1915e727f68dae30e38e0dd007a2d621eb86ffd.png[/img]

[b]Q: Will there be underwater enemies/combat?[/b]
A: No, but the underwater world can be explored for treasures.

[b]Q: Will damage and injury depend on body parts hit?[/b]
A: A headshot with a bow is always a critical hit, and a backstab cannot be blocked.

[b]Q: Will quests be logged in a modern-like system with written objectives, or will it be old-school, like in OG Gothic?[/b]
A: Something in between. We display current objectives on the screen, but they are meant as reminders. For example, if you need to find a character, the task will simply say, "Find Crimson." Details can be found in the journal or by carefully listening to what characters say.

[b]Q: Will there be SteamDeck support?[/b]
A: We've already conducted some tests, and everything works well. We'll provide a final confirmation later.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45307617/2cf127aedc6b28544d69348fd5461571ef9e72c4.png[/img]

[b]Q: Will there be shields?[/b]
A: Enemies will have them, as well as spears. For the protagonist, swords, hammers, axes, daggers, rapiers, maces, etc., will be available.

[b]Q: Why are longswords so slow?[/b]
A: The sword's speed depends directly on its weight. You can find both heavy and light swords. As we’ve mentioned, damage numbers aren’t everything—sometimes a weaker but faster sword might better suit your build.

[b]Q: Will there be a release on PS5 and Xbox?[/b]
A: We’re not ready to comment on that yet.

[b]Q: Will the combat system, as well as movement and facial animations, be refined further?[/b]
A: We will definitely polish some elements, but for the most part, things are finalized.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45307617/c642feefa9074748c2ade4d73bb1af783f945cb8.png[/img]

[b]Q: Will NPCs fight each other? For example, will creatures attack people or bandits attack travelers?[/b]
A: Absolutely. In some cases, you can observe conflicts escalating into full-blown fights.

[b]Q: Does it make sense to pray to the gods? Will there be bonuses?[/b]
A: Absolutely! The more gold you offer, the more beneficial bonuses you’ll receive.

[b]Q: Will there be weapon effects like bleeding, poison, or lightning/fire rune damage that stacks on the enemy or the hero?[/b]
A: Unique weapons have their own effects, including semi-magical ones. In the survival skill tree, you can learn several levels of the bleeding skill. And you can even coat your weapon with poison!

[b]Q: After the ending, does the game finish completely, requiring a new playthrough to re-enter the world?[/b]
A: At the end of the game, the island will change to such an extent that it will simply be impossible to continue the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45307617/3fd4a9838c9a756f2d1460185c309e6eb7bb3b61.jpg[/img]

Once again, thank you for your questions and interest in the project!

notes.title: Q&A with the Devs №2
notes.notes:
[b]Greetings, adventurers![/b]

Thank you for all the questions you left for us on Steam and Discord for Of Ash and Steel. Welcome to Part 2 of the Q&A Session!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45307617/e2a61d882e570434ee894eea1e1be16e90d676ab.jpg[/img]

[b]Q: Will the main story be divided into chapters?[/b]
A: Yes!

[b]Q: Will there be multiple endings?[/b]
A: There will be one main ending, but the world’s final state will reflect your choices, making the conclusion feel unique to your playthrough.

[b]Q: Subterranean exploration: Will there be mines, ruins, or keeps in the rock?[/b]
A: Oh, yes! Expect dungeons, underwater caves, abandoned temples, mines, and crypts. Bring a torch — you’ll need it!

[b]Q: What kind of magic will the game have? Are there schools of magic, or is it limited to support magic/melee-magician hybrid styles?[/b]
A: Magic works similarly to how Jedi use the Force in Star Wars games or how Geralt uses signs in The Witcher.

[b]Q: Will there be secondary abilities such as alchemy, blacksmithing, or horsemanship?[/b]
A: Absolutely! Hunting, leatherworking, alchemy, blacksmithing, armor reinforcement, weapon sharpening, fishing, and more. As for blacksmithing, you can even become a master smith and create unique swords from special metal using your own designs: choosing sword parts, accessories, and even customizing the scabbard to your liking. And then you can upgrade it all further!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45307617/c35a2f8a7a4b330f7f9edaf0c40fa627261e564a.jpg[/img]

[b]Q: Will the game have elements of hardcore modes, like “one life, one save”?[/b]
A: We may add Iron Mode after release.

[b]Q: What about replayability?[/b]
A: From the start, we’ve designed the game to encourage multiple playthroughs to fully experience it. At the very least, you’ll want to play through it with different factions. And when it comes to different builds, the options for replayability expand even further.

[b]Q: How important is a good story and rich lore to the team?[/b]
A: There’s nothing better than immersive gameplay reinforced by a strong story. The story is one of the three core pillars of Of Ash and Steel: narrative, exploration, and progression. We’ve carefully crafted not just the small, everyday details (like holidays and people’s attitudes toward life), but also political, legal, and religious aspects.

[b]Q: Which game engine are you using?[/b]
A: Unreal Engine 4.27.1

[b]Q: Will there be secret quests (not noted in the journal)?[/b]
A: Yes! We categorize quests into three types: classic (logged in the journal, with dialogues, etc.), hidden (not logged in the journal but can involve dialogues and unique mechanics), and exploration-based — where you’ll solve small (or sometimes large) puzzles to access new areas or find treasures. Plus, we’ve prepared over a hundred different random events in the world, some of which unfold over the course of the main story.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45307617/ca27049406c35f1cf84882332596a5028b3d4059.jpg[/img]

[b]Q: Will there be some sort of morality system for the protagonist or factions?[/b]
A: The hero's reputation grows as the character develops and as events unfold in the world. If, at first, people treat you with, at best, condescension, as your influence increases, ordinary people will begin to treat you with greater respect.

[b]Q: Will there be permanent or temporary companions?[/b]
A: Yes, from time to time, you’ll have companions traveling with you.

[b]Q: Will it be possible to create hybrid builds?[/b]
A: Millions of possibilities! A berserk with no HP and a high chance of critical damage, a tin can with no damage but virtually impenetrable, a rogue armed with a dagger with high stamina and high attack speed. You have full control.

[b]Q: Will there be quests that allow you to get unique equipment, additions to characteristics, unique skills?[/b]
A: Yes! Especially if you pay close attention to the world.

[b]Q: Will there be random events on locations without player intervention?[/b]
A: Of course! The world changes, and with these changes come new events.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45307617/88d50152fafa1fcdd8ae4376b5240fc687dc0d37.jpg[/img]

[b]Q: Tell us about the crafting system, if it is planned.[/b]
A: We’ll provide more details later, but in short: we have a rich variety of items — from food to weapons and resources, as well as armor reinforcement and weapon sharpening (which grant permanent bonuses). For experienced crafters, you’ll be able to create your own sword from your own designs, customizing everything, right down to the scabbard.

[b]Q: Will there be in-game books in the game, like in Morrowind and Skyrim?[/b]
A: Absolutely. For those who want to dive deeper into the world of the Kingdom of the Seven, in-game books will be an excellent resource.

[b]Q: Are there plans for early access or a full release?[/b]
A: Full release right away.

[b]Q: Will there be set armor, which if you collect it all, gives a boost?[/b]
A: Yes!

[b]Q: Will there be boss fights?[/b]
A: Yes!

[b]Q: Will it be possible to climb anywhere, or almost anywhere?[/b]
A: Of course — we have free climbing. Just be careful not to fall!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45307617/83b7920876d4840612fe17f69edd709cd950f7e5.jpg[/img]

Once again, thank you for your questions and interest in the project!

notes.title: Q&A with the Devs №1
notes.notes:
[b]Greetings, adventurers![/b]

Thank you for all the questions you left for us on Steam and Discord for Of Ash and Steel. There have been so many that we have decided to publish our answers once a week, every week! Let's start with the first batch:

[b]Q: Could you tell us more about the team at Fire and Frost? When and where was the studio founded?[/b]
A: We began our journey in July 2021. Initially, it was just me (Viktor, from Saint Petersburg) working as a solo indie developer. After finding success at the Unreal Engine Dev Contest, the team grew to four people—we were still very much indie, working on the project in our spare time. Thanks to a small grant from event sponsors, I was able to fully focus on developing the project and presenting it to publishers. About a year later, we reached the pitching stage for Of Ash and Steel, which is how we connected with tinyBuild. After signing the contract, our team expanded to 15 people, and for nearly two years now, we've been working hard on the game.

[b]Q: When did production on Of Ash and Steel start?[/b]
A: We could say we started in July 2021, but only with a small team. The full team joined the project in March 2023.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45307617/225c641a716705e5a76786df704368c18a2db6f0.jpg[/img]

[b]Q: How much of the game has been completed so far?[/b]
A: Most of the game is complete. We’re adding the final quests to the world and moving on to the polishing phase.

[b]Q: What games inspired the mechanics, combat, and gameplay of Of Ash and Steel?[/b]
A: As for combat, it’s something between Dark Souls, Gothic, and The Witcher 3. Gameplay and mechanics, however, are where we tread our unique path. We aim to combine the golden era of RPGs from the 2000s with modern RPG designs, all while bringing our personal touch. It was important for us to maintain a high level of immersion, even in side activities, and to ensure the world reacts to your actions wherever possible.

[b]Q: Will there be magic?[/b]
A: There is magic in the world, but it’s more of an elemental force accessible only to a chosen few. However, the hero can master the Ancient Knowledge, granting him magical abilities.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45307617/ed84fad7ba2099ad5a220370ff8033c1d489813a.jpg[/img]

[b]Q: Do enemies have level scaling?[/b]
A: No, all enemy levels are fixed. We want players to feel their character’s progression. However, over time, more dangerous enemies might appear in the locations you visited before.

[b]Q: Can we make decisions that significantly impact the game? Can we screw ourselves up by making bad choices?[/b]
A: Of course, it’s an RPG! Decisions made in both the main story and side quests can lead to the prosperity or complete destruction of entire locations.

[b]Q: Will there be difficulty settings, and how will they work?[/b]
A: We have three difficulty levels: Story, Classic, and Ash and Steel. The first is a simplified version of Classic—enemies are weaker, and the hero is stronger. Classic is how we envisioned the game. Ash and Steel adds extra challenges to Classic, such as saving only in safe zones and deadly negative effects, but you’ll gain more experience in return!

[b]Q: Is the protagonist silent, or will they be voiced?[/b]
A: All characters will be fully voiced, including the protagonist.

[b]Q: Will there be a toggleable quest helper option?[/b]
A: No, but we understand there’s no fun in searching for a tiny ring in a massive forest. In most cases, you’ll get helpful hints by talking to characters, checking your quest log, or simply observing your surroundings.

[b]Q: With no quest tracking, will fast travel be limited or disabled? Will there be mounts?[/b]
A: Horses went extinct on the island due to an incident involving herbs. BUT! One of the sub-factions has a, uh... rideable creature so to speak. Fast travel via portals will become available later after acquiring Ancient Knowledge.

[b]Q: Is it possible to create a “pure mage” in the game, using only spells in combat?[/b]
A: No.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45307617/c0f3bb994a582e0b80aecf5fbbe05d0ca4b07452.jpg[/img]

[b]Q: Will there be a character editor?[/b]
A: Our hero has a backstory that will significantly impact some events later on. However, you’ll be able to customize his appearance by visiting a barber. Beware of amateurs!

[b]Q: Will the game be released on VK Play?[/b]
A: There are no plans to release the game on VK Play.

[b]Q: What will be the emphasis: world exploration or story quests?[/b]
A: We’re not fans of extremes in games. Everything should be balanced and harmonious.

[b]Q: Will the battle system progression be like in The Witcher 3 or Gothic?[/b]
A: It’s closer to Gothic. Skills require a teacher and meeting attribute requirements.

[b]Q: How many references will there be to popular culture or any works of art?[/b]
A: Mostly from the games we love. Remember the annoying fan in Oblivion? Well, we’ve got a hater!

[b]Q: Will Ancient Knowledge waste any resources?[/b]
A: No, but it has a fairly long cooldown.

[b]Q: Is it possible to kill any enemy using a stick if you try long enough?[/b]
A: It’s possible, but it will be very, very challenging.

[b]Q: A question about the musical score: It’s no secret that background music and ambient sounds make up a significant part of a world’s atmosphere. How is this handled in your project?[/b]
A: We’ve got that covered. Our composer has written around 100 tracks, not only for different locations but also for different times of day. In some cases, the mood even changes based on story events.

[b]Q: Looking at the video, it seems like the game has few conversations with NPCs and quests. How many are there currently?[/b]
A: We already have over 21,000 lines of text just for character interactions (not counting notes, journal entries, etc.). The game has a MASSIVE amount of dialogue.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45307617/8bd873ac4d208f5e3f7d37a3e7fcf6a14f43902f.jpg[/img]

Once again, thank you for your questions and interest in the project — the number of them is absolutely monstrous! On the bright side, this solves the issue of infrequent posts for at least a couple of months, haha.

notes.title: Introducing Of Ash and Steel
notes.notes:
Greetings, adventurers! Come sit closer to the fire—we have a story to tell. 

We’re thrilled to announce Of [b]Ash and Steel[/b], an immersive third-person open-world RPG created by a passionate team that values the essence of classic old-school RPGs and modern designs. Step into the Kingdom of the Seven, a realm brimming with secrets, danger, and opportunities for the bold to shape their own fate.

[h2] [b]Watch the announcement trailer[/b] [/h2]
[previewyoutube=JYB0piWxULE;full][/previewyoutube]
Here’s a first look at what awaits you:

[h2] [b]Master the Art of Combat[/b] [/h2]
You are not a Legendary Hero by default in Of Ash and Steel. Every battle improves your skills. Choose from multiple combat stances and fighting styles, adapting your approach with each encounter. No honor or fighting fairly, because your enemies will do the same!

[h2] [b]Shape the Fate of the World[/b] [/h2]
Your choices matter. Become stronger, forge alliances, and make your mark on a world that reacts to your decisions. From outcast to legend, your journey will leave its mark in one way or another.

[h2] [b]Explore Like You Used To[/b] [/h2]
Rediscover the joy of exploration in a world without quest markers or guides. Every path and hidden treasure is yours to uncover, with a living atmosphere rich in dynamic weather, daily NPC routines, and the sounds of a world that draws you in at every step.


In [b]Of Ash and Steel[/b], we invite you to experience a game inspired by classic RPGs, with no hand-holding, just the thrill of discovery, challenge, and mastery. Are you ready to start your journey? Sharpen your blade and steady your resolve — the Kingdom of the Seven awaits. Your path to glory begins here. Add Of Ash and Steel to your [b]wishlist [/b]today, and join us on this journey!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2893820/Of_Ash_and_Steel 

This is just scratching the surface of what’s possible in the world Of Ash and Steel. We’ll be sharing more details about the game in the coming months, so keep your eyes peeled.

Join our Discord to share a pint and your stories with other adventurers and the devs: https://discord.gg/QDZNNxZmE4

Follow Of Ash and Steel on X for the latest news and updates: https://x.com/OfAshandSteel
